# Vendored Formspec schemas

These JSON Schemas are exact copies of the corresponding files in
`../formspec/schemas/`. They are the runtime schema set for signed Surface
bundle admission in `formspec-web`.

The files were synchronized on 2026-07-28 from the shared Formspec worktree at
commit `c3d5beaa5d72af83f59b42c763be68f8d588ae62`. That worktree also contained
the in-progress v10 updates to App Manifest, Locale, Registry, and Surface, so
`SHA256SUMS` is the exact source identity for this snapshot.

The source repository and these copies are licensed under Apache-2.0.
